description: Join payload vectors (protocol/join.md): version byte, CBOR body, HMAC-SHA256 tag. Every valid payload decodes with join_key to its fields and re-encodes byte for byte; under wrong_key it fails with reason mac. Every invalid one fails with its reason (length, version, mac or body); body vectors carry a correct tag. optional_key_skipped decodes to the fields of node_domination_zone.

invalid.name: tag_mismatch_body_changed
invalid.why: one body bit flipped after signing

invalid.name: game_key_as_text
invalid.why: the game key is a byte string

invalid.name: channel_outside_eu868
invalid.why: 915 MHz is not in an EU868 sub-band

invalid.name: channel_spills_below_g2
invalid.why: 869.40 MHz is the g2 edge: the 125 kHz channel starts at 869.3375 MHz

invalid.name: channel_spills_above_g2
invalid.why: 869.65 MHz is the g2 edge: the 125 kHz channel ends at 869.7125 MHz

invalid.name: channel_spills_above_g3
invalid.why: 870.0 MHz is the g3 edge: the 125 kHz channel ends at 870.0625 MHz

invalid.name: channel_one_hz_over_g2
invalid.why: the highest g2 centre is 869.5875 MHz

invalid.name: team_24_bytes
invalid.why: a team name is at most 23 bytes

invalid.name: empty_team
invalid.why: a team name is at least 1 byte

controller_link.description: Optional keys 13 (ca_sha256, 32 bytes: the field CA's fingerprint) and 14 (urls: 1-3 https base addresses of the controller), RFC 0001 Amendment 4 (proposed), for Android props that link over Wi-Fi (protocol/prop-link.md). The app's, the simulator's and the core's (core/src/join.c, since boxes use them for firmware updates over Wi-Fi: protocol/firmware-update.md) codecs decode and re-encode these byte for byte; keys 15-31 are skipped.

invalid.name: ca_as_text
invalid.why: the fingerprint is a byte string

invalid.name: ca_null
invalid.why: an optional field is left out, never null

box_language.description: Optional key 15 (lang): the language of a box's screens, RFC 0001 Amendment 10 (proposed); 2-8 bytes of a-z, 0-9 and '-', the first two a-z. Absent: English; a box that does not know the language uses English. Made by hand from node_domination_zone's bytes (map of 12, key 15 appended), tagged with Python's hmac module. The core's, the simulator's and the app's codecs decode and re-encode the valid ones byte for byte and refuse the invalid ones (body).

invalid.name: lang_empty
invalid.why: 2-8 bytes; leave the key out instead

invalid.name: lang_bytes
invalid.why: a text, not a byte string

invalid.name: lang_null
invalid.why: leave an optional key out instead of null

mode_fetch.description: Optional keys 16 (fetch_modes) and 17 (forget_modes), phase 5 plan phase 13 (protocol/join.md; protocol/mode-packages.md, 'Fetching missing modes'): CBOR true (0xf5) when set, left out otherwise; false, a number, null or anything else refuses the payload (body). With key 16 a box fetches the signed packages its mode_id needs and lacks from the controller at the addresses of key 14, pinned to key 13 (fetch_modes_without_link is a valid payload, but such a box cannot fetch and answers no_mode); with key 17 it first forgets every package it fetched before. Made by hand from node_domination_zone's bytes (keys 13 and 14 from controller_link's prop_with_ca_and_urls, key 15 'pt'), tagged with Python's hmac module. The simulator's codec decodes and re-encodes the valid ones byte for byte and refuses the invalid ones (body); the core's (core/src/join.c) from plan phase 13b. Readers before them skip keys 16 and 17 like any key up to 31.

invalid.name: fetch_false
invalid.why: true only: leave the key out instead of false

invalid.name: fetch_null
invalid.why: leave an optional key out instead of null

invalid.name: forget_false
invalid.why: true only: leave the key out instead of false

region.description: Optional key 18 (region), RFC 0001 Amendment 12 (proposed; decisions RF-AS923-1 to RF-AS923-12): the field's radio region by its number (1: AS923-TW, Taiwan 920-925 MHz, SF9 at 500 kHz), left out for EU868 (0 written is refused, so a join has one encoding); the channel must fit in that region's sub-bands at its bandwidth (centre +- 250 kHz inside 920-925 MHz for AS923-TW). An unknown region, or a name instead of the number, refuses the payload (body). A box built for another region refuses an authentic join of this region (Kconfig ATALAIA_RADIO_REGION); a reader older than key 18 skips it and checks the channel against EU868, so it refuses it too. Valid ones made with the simulator's codec from node_domination_zone's fields (the fields give region by its name); invalid ones by hand, tagged with Python's hmac module. The simulator's, the core's (core/src/join.c) and the app's codecs decode and re-encode the valid ones byte for byte and refuse the invalid ones (body).

invalid.name: region_zero_written
invalid.why: key 18 = 0: EU868 is the key's absence, so a join has one encoding

invalid.name: region_unknown
invalid.why: key 18 = 2: no such region; a box never guesses its limits

invalid.name: region_text
invalid.why: key 18 is the region's number, not its name

invalid.name: taiwan_with_eu868_channel
invalid.why: region AS923-TW with 869.525 MHz: outside 920-925 MHz

invalid.name: taiwan_channel_without_region
invalid.why: 921.5 MHz without key 18 (EU868): outside every EU868 sub-band, as a reader older than key 18 sees it

invalid.name: taiwan_channel_spills_low
invalid.why: the 500 kHz channel starts below 920 MHz

invalid.name: taiwan_channel_spills_high
invalid.why: the 500 kHz channel ends above 925 MHz

box_beacon.description: Optional key 19 (box_beacon), RFC 0001 Amendment 19 (decision BBC-5, protocol/box-beacon.md): whether the Field Boxes advertise as iBeacons in this game. On (the default) is the key left out, so every older payload keeps its bytes; the GM turning it off writes CBOR false; true, null, a number, text or bytes refuse the payload (body), so a join has one encoding. A reader from before key 19 skips it and (having no beacon) advertises nothing anyway. Valid ones made with the simulator's codec from node_domination_zone's fields (the fields give box_beacon false); invalid ones by hand, tagged with Python's hmac module. The simulator's, the core's (core/src/join.c) and the app's codecs decode and re-encode the valid ones byte for byte and refuse the invalid ones (body).

invalid.name: beacon_true
invalid.why: key 19 is only ever false: on is the key left out

invalid.name: beacon_text
invalid.why: key 19 is a bool, not text

invalid.name: beacon_bytes
invalid.why: key 19 is a bool, not bytes
